chambers.name: The First Weight
chambers.hint: Push the boulder east onto the glowing plate. The golden gate opens when every plate is weighted.

chambers.name: The Waking Watch
chambers.hint: Golems take one step for every two of yours. They find routes around walls, but cannot cross boulders. Space waits; Z undoes.

chambers.name: The Twin Seal
chambers.hint: Two stones, two seals, two watchers. Weight the northern plate, then approach the lower boulder from its west side. Watch the golem beat.
